name: ERTH 4510
title: Applied and Environmental Geophysics
description: Principles of imaging the Earth's interior using observations of electric, magnetic, and gravity fields, with applications to environmental problems.
requirement_description: PHYS 1230 or 1402Q or 1502Q or 1602Q, which may be taken concurrently; MATH 1122Q or 1132Q or 1152Q, which may be taken concurrently.
